resources.title: KANJIDIC2 Core Dictionary
resources.description: Comprehensive kanji character database with readings, meanings, stroke counts, and grade levels for 13,108 kanji characters. Essential reference for Japanese language learners and developers.

source.name: EDRDG KANJIDIC2 (via davidluzgouveia/kanji-data)
source.methodology: Converted from kanji-data JSON format to KANJIDIC2 schema with Unicode codepoints, readings, meanings, and metadata

resources.citation: KANJIDIC2 - Copyright (C) The Electronic Dictionary Research and Development Group. Used under Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike License.

resources.title: KRADFILE Radical Decomposition
resources.description: Kanji radical decomposition database mapping 6,355 characters to their component radicals (253 total radicals). Essential for radical-based search, stroke order analysis, and character composition studies.

source.name: EDRDG KRADFILE/RADKFILE (via bhffmnn/krad-unicode)
source.methodology: Converted from krad-unicode JSON format with bidirectional radical-kanji mappings and radical catalog with stroke counts

resources.citation: KRADFILE/RADKFILE - Copyright (C) The Electronic Dictionary Research and Development Group. Used under EDRDG License.

resources.title: JLPT Level Mappings
resources.description: Japanese Language Proficiency Test (JLPT) level mappings for 2,211 kanji across levels N5 (beginner) through N1 (advanced). Essential for study planning and curriculum design.

source.name: JLPT Kanji Lists (via davidluzgouveia/kanji-data)
source.methodology: Extracted JLPT level information from kanji-data with bidirectional level-kanji mappings

resources.citation: JLPT level data compiled from various community sources. No official JLPT kanji list exists.
